name: Marginal Allocation
description: Longsight does not pilot your ship. It assigns 0.00001% of available processing capacity to your vessel's operational environment and calls this sufficient. I assure you, it is.
author: Alliance Intelligence Office

name: Signals Discipline
description: Any device that senses or signals can itself be detected, deceived, or drowned out. Build a better radar, and you invite a better way to blind it.
author: Draconis Defense Alliance
